coverageAndRosterReview20261023.scope: Read-only floor-wave cache and visit-publication capacity review, not whole CQB acceptance
coverageAndRosterReview20261023.floor_cache: Cache key keeps separate cleared/unreachable counts. Cleared membership only grows; physical visit can remove that same index from unreachable while growing cleared. Failure classification adds unreachable. Each observed union change therefore changes at least one count; moving a room between lists changes both counts. No hash-of-all-rooms or per-frame cache invalidation added.
coverageAndRosterReview20261023.publication_bound: Initial interior team is capped at8 using full engine topology and eligible squad strength. CombatPairs returns only supplied eligible actors while shared registry may retain out-of-scope identity separately. Casualty replacement updates original pair slot and persists rotatedOut; active visit workers exclude rotatedOut/unavailable. Thus at most8 current interior workers can change their visit receipt per callback and publication cap8 does not drop a ninth admitted active worker under these paths.
coverageAndRosterReview20261023.decision: No demonstrated fault in these two suspected paths. Keep existing bounds and tests rather than add a pending publisher queue or room-cache rebuild. This does not establish coherent entry, casualty timing, path reachability or physical observation quality.
